items.title: OTDR fibre testing
items.summary: Optical Time Domain Reflectometry for precise fibre testing, fault finding and link certification.
items.lead: Specialist Optical Time Domain Reflectometry (OTDR) testing for organisations upgrading their networks, with accurate results and minimal disruption.
items.what: A reliable network depends on healthy fibre. OTDR testing measures the condition of every link, locating faults, losses and weak points before they cause outages, so you can upgrade with confidence.
